headline: Allcargo Terminals reports 7% volume drop in September
hook: Volume decline across Allcargo’s terminal network
summary: Allcargo Terminals handled 61,800 TEUs in September, marking a 7% decline compared to the same period last year. Volumes also fell 6% on a month-on-month basis. The company's logistics arm shares closed lower at ₹10.30 on the BSE following the update.
why_it_matters: Lower cargo volumes signal cooling demand in the logistics sector.

headline: Allcargo Logistics credits AI for Q1 turnaround
hook: AI integration drives Allcargo's return to profit
summary: Allcargo Logistics reported a profit in the first quarter, marking a return to the black. The company attributes this financial recovery to the implementation of AI-driven strategies within its logistics operations. This shift aims to optimize supply chain efficiency and improve operating margins. The move highlights a broader trend of Indian logistics firms adopting technology to manage rising costs.
why_it_matters: Operational efficiency gains may improve long-term stock profitability.
